workRoots.description: Git toplevels under any prefix are "work" mode. The first entry is also the parent of the sh-devctl repo: the /validate gate resolves its scripts as <workRoot>/sh-devctl/scripts.

items.description: Absolute path prefix of a work repo root

avenWorkspace.description: Aven workspace name or key forced on every aven call pi-flow makes (skips cwd inference and the search fallback).

landTestCommand.description: Argv of the test command flow_land runs before authorizing a landing (default ["bun","run","test"]). PMR-05HX: the landing gate never trusts a claimed-green suite.

enabled.description: Master switch — telemetry subscribes to nothing when false/absent (PMR-R8AG)

otlpEndpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL (e.g. https://host:4478); spans POST to <endpoint>/v1/traces

headers.description: Static extra headers for OTLP export. Secrets belong in env (PI_FLOW_OTLP_TOKEN), not config

captureContent.description: Content captured on spans (cumulative): off = metadata only (default), text = assistant text, tools = + tool calls the model made and tool input/output, all = + model reasoning. Captured content can contain secrets and lands in the trace backend

maxContentChars.description: Max characters per captured content attribute (default 2000). Tempo truncates attribute values beyond max_attribute_bytes (default 2048) silently — raise both together
